
jvocuhadju (''[[jbocre: jvocu'adju|jvocu'adju]]'') is a lujvo-creation program included with [[jbocre: jbofi'e|jbofi'e]]. Given a sequence of gismu or selrafsi cmavo, it outputs the possible lujvo forms and their scores.

Written by [[jbocre: Richard Curnow|Richard Curnow]], author of [[jbocre: jbofi'e|jbofi'e]].
